name: fabriciq
description: Ask questions about your Power BI reports and semantic models in Microsoft Fabric and get plain-language answers backed by your data.

interface.longDescription: Microsoft Fabric IQ finds the Power BI reports and semantic models you can access in Microsoft Fabric, reads their tables, measures and relationships, writes and runs the DAX query for you, and explains the result in plain language. It runs with your own delegated permissions, respects row-level and object-level security, and is read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes reports, models or measures.
capabilities: Find Power BI reports and semantic models
Read report and semantic model metadata
defaultPrompt: What were total sales by region last quarter?
Which products had the biggest drop in margin compared to last year?
Show the top 10 customers by revenue in the Contoso Sales report.

positive.description: Answer a question from a report
positive.prompt: What were total sales by region last year in the Contoso Sales report?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the report, reads its metadata and the underlying model schema, runs a DAX query, and returns sales by region with the values from the model.

positive.description: Answer a question from a semantic model
positive.prompt: Using the Contoso Sales semantic model, how many orders were placed per month this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the semantic model, reads its schema, runs a DAX query, and returns the monthly order counts.

positive.prompt: Summarize the key numbers in this report: https://app.powerbi.com/groups/REVIEW_WORKSPACE_ID/reports/REVIEW_REPORT_ID
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the URL to the report, reads its metadata, and summarizes its main measures with values from the model.

positive.prompt: What were total sales for the Contoso Bikes product category last year?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses ValueSearch to match the category value in the model, filters the DAX query on it, and returns the total.
When more than one report or semantic model matches, asks the user which one to use instead of guessing.

negative.prompt: Create a new measure called Profit Margin in the Contoso Sales model.
Book a flight to Seattle for next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: ask questions about Power BI reports and semantic models in Microsoft Fabric and get plain-language answers backed by your data.
